name: Big Mike's Burger
kurzbeschreibung: Big Mike’s Burger in Neustift im Stubaital Welcome to Big Mike’s Burger, your ultimate burger joint nestled in the heart of Neustift im Stubaital—where fresh, mouthwatering…
beschreibung: Big Mike's Burger in Neustift im Stubaital is the hotspot for burger enthusiasts in the region. Everything here revolves around juicy patties, crispy buns, and creative toppings. Whether a classic cheeseburger, spicy BBQ burger, or a vegetarian option with grilled halloumi - every burger is freshly grilled to order. Accompanied by homemade french fries and a selection of local craft beers, the rustic interior with wooden tables creates a relaxed atmosphere. A must-visit after a day exploring the Stubai Alps.
